'''Essien''' was a [[Planet/Legends|world]] in the [[Halthor sector/Legends|Halthor sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].

==History==
Essien was attacked by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorians]] during the [[Mandalorian Wars]]. Former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Zayne Carrick]] took part in the [[Essien landing|battle]] alongside the [[Phaeda Militia]] and several [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]].
